gameplay_map: Idle: below 1 stud/s. MoveStart: leaving idle. RunLow to RunHigh: blended by speed. LeanLeft/LeanRight: weight follows the steering curve. Coast: moving with no input. PunchLeft/PunchRight: alternate over everything below Action. HitReact: confirmed hit. KnockbackFall: while knockback is strong. Victory: round winner. Propel: during the propel burst.
note: roblox-animation. Standard R6 joints only, no root motion, and gameplay code owns all movement. Punch strike time must equal Punch.Windup.
